integrity: Independent audit absent; the finite checker tests identities and illustrations but does not replace the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact local orbital Floquet theory for a prescribed symmetric two-orientation, directed, cubic-coupled three-oscillator network; not global synchronization, boundary nonlinear stability, or a claim of infinitely many windows for fixed reactive coupling.
title: Unbounded switching-rate stability reentrance in a directed Stuart–Landau triad
